$comment: Applied by `deno task jsr:metadata` (infra/scripts/jsr-metadata.ts) via JSR's PATCH package API. Each package gets its own description, its GitHub repository link, and the runtime flags this repo can back with evidence: `deno: true` everywhere (every package is type-checked and tested on Deno in CI), plus `browser: true` only for the two packages with zero `Deno.*` usage anywhere in their sources (validation, time). See CONTRIBUTING.md 'Maintaining' for how to run this against the real API.

email.description: SMTP sending, address parsing, an HTML mail wrapper, and a DKIM signature checker for incoming mail.

integrations.description: Ntfy and healthchecks.io clients, an inbound webhook signature checker, and retry backoff.

net.description: Guards for outbound requests to user-supplied URLs: SSRF checks, a redirect-safe fetch, and size-capped body readers.

platform.description: Shared and per-runtime primitives: a command/query/event bus, a cache, API result types, rate limiting, tokens, and browser storage.

realtime.description: Hint-only WebSocket transport: connection registry, heartbeat, reconnect, and cursor-based sync.

server.description: Deno-server primitives for a small SaaS backend: sign-in, Postgres, S3-compatible storage, Redis, outbox, request logging.

time.description: IANA time-zone arithmetic on Intl, and an iCalendar (.ics) writer.

validation.description: arktype `validate` with one result shape, and the form-validation state model.
